newsitem.title: USA: SMT Health to be bought by Apollo unit.
newsitem.headline: SMT Health to be bought by Apollo unit.

text.p: SMT Health Services Inc said Tuesday it would be acquired by Apollo Management L.P. unit Three Rivers Acquisition Corp for $11.75 per share, or $100 million including debt, stock options and warrants.
The deal will be structured as a cash tender offer to commence within five business days. to be followed by a merger, the diagnostic imaging company said.

The tender offer and merger are not subject to financing but will be subject to customary conditions, including the tender of a majority of SMT's fully diluted shares and the obtaining of any necessary regulatory and third party approvals, SMT said.
